name: 패밀리 포켓몬 카드 게임
englishName: Sun & Moon Family Pokémon Card Game

description.text: Sun & Moon Family Pokémon Card Game, released in Korean on 3 May 2019: three 60-card decks with six holo cards each, a coin, damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, two GX markers, a two-player playmat, a deck case, a rule book, a start guide and a card box.
